g.text: Does the observer use target rather than foil evidence?
Empirical final positive choices with 95% Wilson intervals. Negative = opposite-sign or unchanged target. Blue: target rotation. Amber: designated
next-location foil, conditioning target unchanged. Zero is the all-zero catch sweep only. 0/3/6/10 degrees are analysis-only OOD magnitudes;
15/30/45 are native. Native pattern couples foil rotations; these are conditional descriptions, not independently randomized evidence weights.
